name: dev-juniper-lab-superuser

irregularities.action: Left alone. To remove it later: delete system tacplus-server 198.18.0.24

the SNMP contact is NOC <noc@example.net> (the device has: the SNMP contact is example contact)

region: configure private
# aaa: the accounting events tacctl renders
set system tacplus-server 192.0.2.10 secret <secret>
set system tacplus-server 192.0.2.10 single-connection
delete system accounting events interactive-commands
# snmp: the client list tacctl renders
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 192.0.2.10/32
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 198.51.100.0/24
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 0.0.0.0/0 restrict
set snmp community <secret> client-list-name TACCTL-SNMP
set snmp location "Rack 4, DC1"
set snmp contact "NOC <noc@example.net>"
set snmp description "Core switch"
delete snmp community <secret> clients 198.18.0.0/20
delete snmp community <secret> clients 198.19.0.0/16
delete snmp community <secret> clients 0.0.0.0/0
# mgmt-acl: the management filter tacctl renders (its terms, their leaves and their order)
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port 830
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port 830
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term default-accept then accept
show | compare | no-more
